# JOITA Bioseed AI

Last updated: 2026-08-14

JOITA Bioseed AI integrates AI-powered crop advisory, advanced crop inputs, soil intelligence, edge sensing, and validation-led deployment for smallholder agriculture.

## Product Portfolio

- BioSynth Prime: waste-to-value FA-WAP hydrogel platform developed from rice stubble, fly ash, and Bacillus subtilis, currently undergoing field evaluation.
- BioSynth Nano: next-generation crop-input platform combining functional nanomaterials with data-guided application strategies.
- FarmAssist AI: AI-powered field assistant with offline-first crop guidance, live AI when configured, weather context, disease support, soil recommendations, market prices, and locally relevant farm records.
- SmartSeedMat: seed and nursery support material developed for early-stage establishment and practical deployment.
- AquaSynth Nano: aquaculture technology platform for water-quality management, controlled pilots, and validation-led deployment.
- AgriTrust TriLeaf Edge Node: design-protected agricultural IoT sensing and edge-computing device for localized root-zone field intelligence and FarmAssist data loops.
- JOITA Soil Sathi App: field companion for recording and managing moisture, temperature, EC, pH, fertility, NPK readings, and supervised field records.

## Safety And Claims

JOITA uses advisory, validation-focused wording and avoids absolute performance promises. Product and AI recommendations are for support only. Farmers should confirm pesticide or fertilizer decisions with local labels, KVK, agriculture experts, and applicable regulations.
